assets.prompt: Create one original premium dark fantasy RPG cinematic background, landscape 16:9 composition, painterly detailed anime realism, restrained gothic elegance, tactile worn oak and limestone, warm late morning light from HIGH WEST/LEFT WINDOWS, cool east shadows. NO PEOPLE, NO WORDS, NO UI, no symbols copied from other games. Reference image is the ACTUAL top-down playable room and is a strict spatial plan, not a style reference. Reinterpret at human eye level looking from the SOUTH entrance toward the NORTHEAST. Modest single rectangular stone chapel, NOT a huge cathedral, no extra halls or rooms. North altar/pulpit at rear right with two brass candles; one long low oak ceremony table in the middle-right with a list paper and a cup on top; backless wooden benches to left and along right edge. Broad clear center aisle with worn burgundy runner. East SIDE DOOR visibly on right wall beside ceremony table. South door is behind camera. Preserve plausible distance from table right end to east door, leave clear floor there for three adult characters to confront one another. North altar is distinct from central oak table. Camera low enough for intimate character staging, tabletop about center height. Empty floor lower half will receive separately rendered character cutouts. Beautiful nuanced volumetric morning light, unlit corners, tiny dust motes; no purple magical fog, no giant cathedral columns. Image should be a finished production background plate with zero text or borders.
